header: How the scheduling board handles a busy week
subheadline: 140 technicians, 1,100 planned visits and whatever breaks on Tuesday. Dispatchers keep this screen open all day.

items.title: Planned work and breakdowns on one calendar
items.description: Maintenance contracts create their own visits. An emergency never goes into a slot already promised to a quarterly service.

items.title: Skills and certifications filter the list
items.description: Only technicians with a valid refrigerant certificate appear for an F-gas job. The board warns six weeks before a certificate expires.

items.title: Travel time shown before you decide
items.description: Each candidate shows the drive from their previous call. A 40-minute detour becomes a decision someone makes, not an accident.

items.title: One drag reschedules everyone affected
items.description: Moving a job reorders the rest of that technician's day. Customers whose time windows change get a message in the same step.
